fixed.explanation: BindCreateTriggerInfo only accepts base tables (views are rejected). TryExpandTriggers only collects BEFORE and AFTER triggers, so an INSTEAD OF trigger on a base table is stored but never fires. The edit rejects any timing other than BEFORE or AFTER at creation, so the user gets an error instead of a silently ignored trigger.
